_comment: Machine-specific cleanup sources for the archeotech Storage panel (format: archeotech-shell docs/STORAGE.md). Stowed as a single file into ~/.config/archeotech, which also holds the shell's own state.

sources.label: uv cache (cdx)
sources.cost: Python packages download again on the next uv sync in a cdx session

sources.label: Old cdx profile {name}
sources.cost: A profile cdx marked for removal on {mtime}; it goes to the Trash

sources.label: Old backup {name}
sources.cost: Backup made on {mtime}; check nothing in it is still needed. It goes to the Trash
